Players Committee card image of [[Stolen Data Tapes (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E3), game text: “Deploy on R2-D2. If about to leave table (for any reason, even if inactive), relocate to Dune Sea. If at Dune Sea, may relocate to your character there. If at Alderaan (or a 'blown away' system), tapes 'delivered'; relocate this Effect to table and may take any card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/stolendatatapes_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a48c2e81cc3088f72a385f3f4d68256d8012369f a48c2e8] (8 October 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
